signUp.subject: Welcome!
signUp.title: Welcome!
signUp.body: Your account has been created. We are glad to have you here.
signUp.preview: Your account has been created. Welcome aboard.
signUp.verificationNote: You will receive a separate email with a link to confirm your email address.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
resetPassword.text:
We received a request to reset your password.

Choose a new password: {{values.actionUrl}}

This link can be used once and expires 24 hours after the request.

If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this email. Your password will stay unchanged.
resetPassword.preview: Choose a new password using your secure reset link.
resetPassword.expiryNotice: This link can be used once and expires 24 hours after the request.
resetPassword.securityNotice: If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this email. Your password will stay unchanged.

verification.subject: Verify your email
verification.title: Verify your email
verification.body: Please confirm that this email address belongs to you.
verification.text:
Please confirm that this email address belongs to you.

Verify your email address: {{values.actionUrl}}

This link can be used once and expires 7 days after the request.

If you did not create this account or request verification, you can ignore this email.
verification.preview: Confirm your email address to complete verification.
verification.expiryNotice: This link can be used once and expires 7 days after the request.
verification.securityNotice: If you did not create this account or request verification, you can ignore this email.

Your email address has been verified successfully.

You can return to the application and continue using your account: {{values.clientUrl}}
successfullyVerified.preview: Your email address is now verified.
successfullyVerified.nextStep: You can return to the application and continue using your account.

We sent this notification to your previous email address to keep you informed.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

successfullyUpdatedEmail.previousAddressNotice: We sent this notification to your previous email address to keep you informed.
successfullyUpdatedEmail.securityNotice: If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.
